content:
ShiMetaPi Pico-G1 is a compact development board with Ethernet and MIPI CSI connectors designed for AI Vision applications and powered by a GOKE GK7206 dual-core Cortex-A7 SoC with 128MB or 256MB on-chip DDR3L memory. The board also features a 16MB SPI flash and a microSD card for storage, a USB Type-C port for power and OS flashing, an RTC battery connector, and two 20-pin GPIO headers for expansion with I2C, UART, PWM, SPI, and so on. ShiMetaPi Pico-G1 specifications: SoC – GOKE GK7206 CPU Dual-core Cortex-A7 processor clocked up to 1.0 GHz RISC-V coprocessor up to 400 MHz GPU – N/A VPU – H.265 / H.264 hardware encoder ISP – 2F-WDR, AI NR, 3DNR, LDC; input up to 3840 x 2160 @ 20 fps NPU – 1.0 TOPS On-chip Memory – 128MB DDR3L (GK7206V11A) or 256MB DDR3L (GK7206V12A) Storage 16 MB NOR flash MicroSD card slot Camera Interface – 4-lane [...]
